$description: Theme-invariant layout tokens. Edit here to retune app-wide measurements. The radius steps feed Tailwind's --radius-* namespace (utilities rounded-xs/sm/md/lg); section-gap* is the single owner of the vertical rhythm between sections.

radius-xs.$description: Radius scale, monotonic. Rule: inner radius = outer radius - padding.

radius-lg.$description: Base window / card radius (was the old `radius` token, which had no var() consumers).

radius-full.$description: Pill. Owned so `rounded-full` and raw CSS blocks (chips, dots, CTAs) share one value instead of each spelling 9999px.

section-gap.$description: Vertical rhythm owner, consumed by .section-y. Calibrated to the legacy painted rhythm it replaced (WindowChrome my-8 = 32px between windows) so Phase 3 does not move the layout; retune HERE from now on. Windows must NOT add their own my-* on top of it.

section-gap-sm.$description: Dense blocks / intra-section spacing (also the terminal-fog anti-FOUC headroom p-4 in Index.tsx, whose sum with section-gap is 28px = the old p-4).

window-pad-y.$description: Guaranteed vertical padding inside every WindowChrome body (the old p-4 md:p-6 gave 16/24px and Education read cramped). Consumed by WindowChrome's content wrapper; horizontal padding stays px-4 md:px-6.
